name: Cargo Bay
subtitle: A path through black serenity

props.label: Return to ships bridge
props.note: This passage in the upper middle part of the room leads to Ships Bridge. Walk into the marked threshold to take that route.

props.label: Lower Decks
props.note: This passage in the lower left part of the room leads to Lower Decks. Walk into the marked threshold to take that route.

props.label: Data Nexus
props.note: This transport route in the upper middle part of the room leads to Data Nexus. Walk into the marked threshold to take that route.

description: The cargo bay is a metal-walled hold with a broad clear loading floor in the middle. Crates, containers, a small lifting vehicle and shelving are packed along the edges. A large circular transport platform glows blue on the right beside a destination display and a small control desk. The upper passage is labelled To Captain's Deck, and a stair on the lower left is marked To Lower Decks. A wide loading-bay doorway sits at the bottom. Amber wall lights soften the grey plating, while floor markings, scuffed panels and the bright transport ring make the separate working areas easy to locate.
